attempts.notes: Inline assembly in Solidity does not support `else` branches on `if`; replaced with a second `if iszero(...)` block. Also typed the mask expression explicitly is unnecessary; kept plain typed assignments.
Replaced `!(0x1f & length)` with `(0x1f & length) == 0` (uint256 has no `!`), and cast the `0x20` literal to `uint256` in both `abi.encodePacked` calls so packed encoding of literals is allowed.

Fixed the assembly `if ... else` (inline assembly `if` has no else branch) by rewriting it as a `switch` statement. Also replaced `!(0x1f & length)` with an explicit `== 0` comparison, since Solidity's `!` operator only accepts `bool`, and made the `abi.encodePacked` arguments explicitly typed as `bytes32` to avoid literal-type ambiguity.
